title: Australia: audit the pass-through
impact: Cost direction: lower interchange; net savings unquantified.
method: Direction follows the RBA’s cap reductions. Merchant impact needs transaction mix and contracted pass-through; no basis-point estimate is claimed.
move: Reconcile October fees against September, holding card mix constant.

title: NZ: price the commercial-card reset
impact: Cost direction: lower regulated interchange; merchant savings unquantified.
method: Direction follows the Commission’s decision. No conversion to merchant basis points without commercial-card share and acquirer terms.
move: Ask for an April repricing plan and a commercial-card mix report.

title: UK: make fee evidence usable
impact: Impact direction: greater transparency; no guaranteed fee reduction.
method: Governance and disclosure duties do not themselves set merchant prices. No numeric savings estimate is claimed.
move: Build a fee-line inventory now; map each trigger to the acquiring invoice.
